notes.title: Diesel Power Update 1.3 - Vehicle Physics Overhaul
notes.notes:
Changes

    Vehicle physics re-done fixing bouncing issues 
    Adjustments to vehicle "feel" and control
    Mirror setting limited to Oculus Rift HMDs (Performance hit on HTC Vive)
    Minor text fixes


 Known Issues

    Falling from great height onto the track will bounce the vehicle off to the sky

notes.title: Diesel Power Update 1.2.1 - Bug Fixes & Engine Update
notes.notes:
The return of shadows! To ensure constant performance for low level PC's Diesel Power makes use of Unreal Engines Forward Render which did not have dynamic shadows until now.


Changes
- Update to Unreal Engine 4.15 to make use of Forward Renderer with dynamic shadows and more
- Added sound cues to menu items
- Added controller dummy in menu for visual represantion of controller mappings
- Lobby colours adjusted
- Minor text fixes

Bug fixes
- Vehicle shooting in the sky should be fixed. Please report in if you encounter this issue
- Menu selection needing mutliple input actions fixed
- Motion controller jet effect (visual and sound) fixed

notes.title: Diesel Power Update 1.2 - Leaderboards!
notes.notes:
Diesel Power is on track for a release in February 2017!
Leaderboards have been added and please keep in mind that they can be reset until release!

 Added

    Gobal HighScore Leaderboard (crossplatform ready)
    Gobal LobbyScore Leaderboard (crossplatform ready)
    Restructured Menu including new "Exit" and "Start Game" options
    Item description at "Start Screen"
    Experimental: Motion Controller support (know issue: audio bug on throttle)

notes.title: Diesel Power Update 1.1.2 - HMD & Visual Optimization
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27490538/0262b27d9c4eff4c421a5ffc9e1cb5c96a3afd97.png

    "HMD mirror" resolution options


 Changes

    Supersampling: Resolution upped 40%
    Viewing distance and quality increased
    Sun angle and inclination
    Re-arranged "current points" pop up

    Unreal Engine "Client Usage Data" deactivated

notes.title: Diesel Power Update 1.1 - Quality Of Life Improvements
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27490538/c5bf141b28056d724040fc93d5b0bbf7f426be1b.png

Added in v1.1


    Visual clues added to facilitate the players first steps
"HMD mirror mode" settings for Oculus Rift
Screenshot and pause button
Keyboard bindings for left and right-handed players (Movement: WASD/ Arrow; Action: CTRL, Num1; Lobby: L; Restart: R)
    

Changes in v1.1


    Start menu in lobby restructured    
"Recenter HMD" button remapped to "D-Pad Right"
Changed effect below car for better sense of depth
New hover car visuals
New hover car engine and turbine sounds
Moved camera closer to the vehicle
Minor track fix (removal of double spawn)
